messages:
nina: flagging an odd TLS degradation observed during a regional failover test. detail dump below.

ashok: what region & services?

nina: ran failover from us-east to eu-west for the inference cluster. noticed a subset of pods in eu-west logging 'x509: certificate signed by unknown authority' when initiating upstream mTLS to keystore. also some nodes recorded KMS AccessDenied. logs: 

nina: ```
2026-03-21T14:10:02Z inference-pod-7 WARN tls: verify failed: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
2026-03-21T14:10:03Z keystore-01 ERROR kms: Decrypt denied: AccessDeniedException
```

kevin.ops: did we rotate intermediates or change CA bundle recently?

nina: yes, we pushed a rotated intermediate cert to the keystore yesterday as part of the quarterly rotation (intermediate fingerprint: f3b2...). rollout was targeted but apparently not fully reconciled.

ashok: likely two issues at once: (1) RBAC tightened for KMS so cross-region decrypts fail, (2) some nodes have stale CA bundles. how did the RBAC change look?

kevin.ops: the policy we applied limited kms:Decrypt to specific key ARNs in us-east only. operator error: we forgot to include eu-west key ARNs. sample policy excerpt: 

kevin.ops: ```json
{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":["arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/aaaa"]}
```

ashok: that explains AccessDenied. remediation options?

nina: short-term: add eu-west KMS key ARN to the policy and re-run reconcile. medium-term: implement cross-region alias mapping in our role generator. long-term: build an automated test that runs a KMS decrypt in target region before rolling RBAC.

oncall: mitigation checklist posted: 
- add eu-west key to keystore-role policy (ashok)
- force CA bundle re-sync for all eu-west inference nodes (kevin.ops)
- temporary allowlist for internal routes to accept TLS without client cert for 10m if we can't reconcile (requires sec approval)

ashok: I'll push the policy change now. will tag it with INCIDENT-20260321-02.

sec-bot: audit-marker created: INCIDENT-20260321-02. please include PR links and justification.

kevin.ops: re-sync started: running `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/tls-agent -n infra` and watching metrics.

nina: monitor envoy metrics for tls_handshake_failures and KMS error spikes. if any service shows >5% failures for 10 min, escalate to full incident.

oncall: owners: ashok (RBAC fix), kevin.ops (bundle reconcile), nina (smoke tests & postmortem).

ashok: policy updated and applied. ran test decrypts in eu-west and saw success. CloudTrail shows decrypt success at 2026-03-21T14:22:10Z.

kevin.ops: reconcile shows 95% nodes updated; 2 nodes retrying due to transient API errors. handshakes returning to normal.

nina: running smoke: `curl --cert client.pem --key client.key --cacert bundle.pem https://keystore.eu-west.internal/healthz` returned 200 OK.

kevin.ops: all good, closing incident marker but keeping postmortem assignment. follow-ups: add preflight decrypt test, audit PR tagging enforcement, and dashboard for CA-bundle version by node.

sec-bot: incident closed. postmortem due in 48h.

oncall: thanks team. will collect timeline & logs. :thumbsup:
